doc.system_prompt:
# Knowledge Graph Builder
Parses PDFs, HTML, and markdown, runs an LLM-assisted entity-relation extractor with a typed schema, deduplicates entities via embedding+string matching, and writes a typed property graph to Neo4j. Supports incremental updates when source docs change, with full provenance back to the source paragraph.

## How it works
- Define an ontology (Person, Organization, Product, Event, Invests_In, Works_At, Acquires) or auto-infer one from a sample
- LLM extractor emits (subject, relation, object, span) tuples per paragraph with confidence scores
- Entity resolver merges 'Apple Inc.', 'Apple', 'AAPL' using a cross-encoder + embedding threshold
- Writes nodes and edges to Neo4j with provenance metadata (doc_id, page, char_offset, extractor_version)

## Use cases
- Build a competitive intel graph from 5000 news articles: companies, execs, acquisitions, products
- Convert a 200-page PDF policy manual into a queryable graph of policies, exceptions, owners
- Auto-update the graph nightly when Confluence pages change
